verdict.rationale: The evidence covers the desktop app, the `lms` CLI commands and the llmster headless daemon, but never shows LM Studio being installed through a standard package manager such as brew, apt, winget, npm or pip. A community comment calling it a "simple install" describes the app installer, not package-manager distribution, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can install the runtime quickly using a standard package manager
